  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester Makeup Examination, June -2025  
  NEURAL NETWORKS AND DEEP LEARNING [CSE-3273]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Inspect the estimation error produced by the Wiener filter using Gauss-Newton method  
  for solving a linear least-squares problem  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Outline the three heuristics that significantly improve the back-propagation algorithm's  
  performance.                                                                                (3)  
  
  C)      Illustrate solving the XOR problem using hidden functions of Radial basis network.          (2)  
  2)           Solve using K means clustering algorithm with Euclidean distance method to cluster the  
  following data into two groups.  
  $$Data points=X= {2,4,10,12,3,20,30,11,25}                                               (5)$$  
  $$A)      Initial Cluster centroid is c1=4 and c2=11.$$  
  
  B)      Make use of competitive learning algorithms to implement the features used in Self  
  organizing maps using python programming.                                                   (3)  
  
  C)      Explain the Nonlinear AutoRegressive with eXogenous inputs (NARX) model                     (2)  
  3)           Develop a mathematical derivation to prove that energy function is decreasing and  
  network settles into stable state for stability condition of the Hopfield Network.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Make use of associative memory method to implement the Hop-field network using  
  $$python programming when original_pattern=[1,1,-1,1,1,-1,-1] and                             (3)$$  
  $$noisy_pattern=[-1,1,-1,1,-1,-1,-1] is given as input to the program.$$  
  
  C)      Compare multiclass and multilabel classification with examples.                             (2)  
  4)           Compare regularization techniques such as Lasso regression and Ridge regression along  
  with mention the purpose of using regularization in neural networks.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Outline the various difficulties of training Deep Neural Networks (DNN).                    (3)  
  C)      Examine the impact of Batch Normalization on neural networks considering few                (2)
